5706.title: ACP authentication method selection blocks gated sessions
5706.rootCauseOneLine: Both ACP bridges select only special authentication method IDs and skip authentication for other advertised IDs, leaving gated sessions unable to start.
5706.proposedFix: Define safe protocol-driven method selection and bounded authentication-required recovery in both bridges; authentication changes are excluded from the autopilot simple-fix policy.
5706.caveats: Bridge-level reproduction repeated in a second clean checkout by the same investigator. External agent, packaged release, and protocol specification conformance were not independently tested. Reproduction code and selected output are inline in the report.
